The other guns

I know another tune by this title is in the database at thesession.org, but this is a different tune. It’s usually used as the last tune in the last set of the night at a session I go to. Some rhythmic variations are done in the B-part,
f2>a2 dfaf | e2>a2 ceae, etc
giving it a fun tilt. All in all - I think it’s a pretty cheap tune, but it has enough magic in it to keep things fun.

The original version

The transcriptions above are very close to how the tune was written. I have put in the version as actually written and played by Jim. He wrote the tune out for me many years ago when I did some gigs with the band. Although it sounds like there is a pause in the music in the second part, there actually isn’t. You just hold the ‘d’ and ‘c’ in the 1st and 2nd part slightly longer and put in the 2 ‘a’ notes just afterwards. This gives the tune the jazzy feel that was so characteristic of the ‘Easy Club’ sound. Just pausing the tune is much less elegant and less in keeping with the effect they wanted to produce

Re: The Easy Club, X:12

@DonaldK - your setting is essentially what is played by Easy Club on “The Shetland Sessions, Vol. 1,” Track 13, second tune in the set after Janine’s Reel (Lismore Recordings LCOM 7021). The only and very minor difference is that for the fourth and fifth notes in each of the first three bars of the second strain, the fifth note is the same as the fourth with the those two notes tied together instead of popping back up to high A. In the fourth bar, the two B’s in your notation would likewise be tied together. The overall effect is a syncopation that I, at least, find exciting and central to the “turn” of the tune. (What was that I read elsewhere in the comments for another tune? … Oh yes: “Hate mail inbound in 3 … 2 … 1 …”]

Re: The Easy Club

Finally worked out how the syncopation originally worked.
The tune was originally played with swing, so the start of the second part would sound something like:
f>aa>d- (3daa g>a|e>aa>c- (3caa g>a| etc.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on November 25th, 2024.

Re: The Easy Club

Interesting @DonaldK, I don’t hear those triplets at all. To get the midi to playback as I hear the syncopation I tried | f>aa>d- d>ag>a | e>aa>c- c>ag>a | which sounded wrong, then | f>aa<d- d>ag>a|e>aa<c- c>ag>a | which also sounded wrong. Then I took out the ‘swing’ between 3rd and 4th notes in each bar and it seems to play pretty close to how I hear it.
